shots.name: crt-screen-inspector
shots.alt: The CRT Screen card in Properties, Effects at its defaults: Mix, Curvature, Line Count 240, Line Depth, Mask (Aperture Grille), Mask Strength, Mask Size, Flicker and Speed, each a slider with a value field and reset

marks.label: Curvature: how much the screen bulges
Line Count: lines down the picture
Mask Strength: the red, green and blue stripes
Bypass, to compare with the original

shots.name: analog-signal-lab-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with the Analog Signal Lab card at its defaults: the Preset menu, then the sections Signal (Mix, Channel Seed), PAL Encode / Decode, RF Channel, Reception, Multipath, Receiver, VHS Transport and CRT Display, each control a slider with a value field and reset, beside a strip of the preview with the dancer
shots.caption: Analog Signal Lab at its defaults. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Mix: original to signal. 3 — RF / Antenna Stage: the antenna part. 4 — VHS Stage: the tape part. 5 — CRT Stage: the tube part.
